tasks.name: Observe current target truth
acceptance: Environment facts are observed without exposing secrets
No repository or public resource is created without Owner authorization

tasks.name: Place and adapt the frozen candidate
acceptance: L0/L1 scope is unchanged
python and shell sources are valid
existing better target implementation is preserved
tasks.rollback: restore pre-change target worktree or revert the candidate-only change

tasks.name: Provision production configuration and ingress
acceptance: secrets are generated and not committed
DeepSeek key remains absent from the package and deployment logs
domain resolves to the intended target
80/443 conflict is resolved through the existing proxy or package Caddy
tasks.rollback: remove only the new route/config and retain data

tasks.name: Deploy application and reverse proxy
acceptance: container doctor is ready
legacy sensitive fields are encrypted and upload object names are opaque
readyz is healthy
app is not directly exposed to the public network

tasks.name: Execute isolated full golden transaction and AI fault matrix
acceptance: all tests pass
direct identifiers are absent from DeepSeek-bound content
AI cannot override deterministic eligibility
401/402/429/500/503 paths do not break the core workflow
restart retains application evidence
encrypted recovery artifact exists

tasks.name: Execute full live HTTPS transaction, restart readback and cleanup
acceptance: real HTTPS login is reachable
an isolated temporary identity completes onboarding, resume upload, job analysis, application pack and progress recording
the same business result is readable after application-container restart
temporary credentials never enter evidence and the acceptance identity/data/files are removed
no material browser console errors
tasks.rollback: temporary user cleanup is mandatory; restore previous image or remove new ingress route if the live transaction fails

tasks.name: Prepare Owner web activation and verify DeepSeek when the key is available
acceptance: Owner pastes the key only in the authenticated settings page
the full key is never echoed, logged, exported or committed
official V4 Flash and V4 Pro identifiers are used
a failed or absent verification keeps AI unavailable while the rule workflow remains usable and the release remains explicitly conditional
tasks.rollback: use the web revoke action; rules-only operation remains available

tasks.name: Bind existing long-term sync and status integrations
acceptance: available authorized integrations are connected
missing integrations remain explicitly not_configured
provider keys and credentials are excluded from canonical export
no false synced state
tasks.rollback: disable timers/adapters; core app remains usable

tasks.name: Freeze evidence, release, commit and hand off
acceptance: no unresolved P0/P1
core_result is PASS
overall PASS requires DeepSeek ready and authorized long-term sync ready
Owner receives no technical setup work beyond the one-time key paste
tasks.rollback: revert repository change and invoke code rollback; preserve recovery data
